name: Guanacaste
summary: Guanacaste is Costa Rica's north Pacific surf coast, built around Tamarindo's surf schools and the boat-access breaks of Santa Rosa National Park.
season: Waves work year-round. The green season, May to November, generally brings the bigger Pacific swells.

name: Nicoya Peninsula
summary: The Nicoya Peninsula pairs consistent beach breaks with a strong wellness scene, centred on Nosara and Santa Teresa.
season: Waves work year-round. The green season, May to November, generally brings the bigger Pacific swells.

name: Central Pacific
summary: The Central Pacific is the closest surf coast to San José, with Jacó's beginner-friendly waves, Playa Hermosa's heavier beach break and the long left at Barranca.
season: Waves work year-round. The green season, May to November, generally brings the bigger Pacific swells.

name: South Pacific
summary: The South Pacific runs from Dominical's river-split beach breaks to Pavones, known as one of the longest left-hand waves in the world.
season: Waves work year-round. The green season, May to November, generally brings the bigger Pacific swells.

name: Caribbean
summary: The Caribbean coast has one headline wave, the expert-only Salsa Brava reef break at Puerto Viejo.
season: Its best season runs opposite to the Pacific, generally the northern-hemisphere winter months.
